description: Consensus positioning of the largest Hyperliquid perp traders plus current funding rates — i.e. what big leveraged money is actually long or short, and what it costs to hold that side. A coin held by fewer than 3 of the read whales is reported NEUTRAL whatever its long/short split (one whale is 100% of the traders holding a coin, which is not a consensus), and any whale accounts that could not be read this pass are reported rather than counted as flat.
name: get_hyperliquid_whales

available.description: False when this call has no data — a snapshot that is not warm yet, a domain switched off, or an argument that was rejected. NOT an error, and NOT a statement about the market.

fetchedAt.description: Per-leg refresh times — positioning and funding age independently.

funding.description: Perp funding rates, their extremes, divergences and momentum.

available.description: False when the funding leg could not be read.

divergences.description: Assets whose funding disagrees across venues.

extremes.description: Most positive and most negative funding.

marketRegime.description: Regime implied by funding across the book.

limit.description: Row cap applied to every list in this payload.

reason.description: Why the payload is absent, when `available` is false.

truncated.description: Present only when a list was cut to `limit`.

originalLengths.description: Field name → its full length before the cut.

whales.description: Whale positioning: the consensus read, the bullish/bearish assets and the traders behind it.

available.description: False when the positioning leg could not be read.

bearishAssets.description: Assets the cohort is net short.

bullishAssets.description: Assets the cohort is net long.

consensus.description: Net directional read across the traders.

tradersRequested.description: Traders the pass tried to read — a gap means partial coverage.

title: Hyperliquid Whale Positioning
